data.action: 坐在轮椅上双手合十，在圣光中垂眸祈祷
data.description: 【蕾缪安 · 拉特兰教堂】拉特兰圣所高耸的彩绘玻璃长窗下，神圣的金色圣光倾泻在轮椅之上。头顶悬浮着清透光环的蕾缪安双手合十垂眸祈祷，神情圣洁安宁如画中天使——「赞美万物归一的秩序。但愿这片大地上的纷争与硝烟，终有一日能在钟声中迎来彻底的平息。」
data.promptProse: Lemuen bows her head in prayer from the high-tech wheelchair, hands joined above the warm lap blanket and dark tailored overcoat. White collared shirt, black tie and trousers retain the outfit beneath her translucent halo. The symmetrical medium view follows Laterano cathedral's stone aisle toward tall stained glass. Golden and colored window light illuminate her hands and wheelchair frame, pooling across the floor while side pillars remain softly shaded.
data.title: 蕾缪安 · 拉特兰教堂
